sources.title: MetaBot client schedule tables (UTC+9 Global interpretation)
Wikily field bosses and spawn locations

rift.note: Global clock sources disagree. Select a published interpretation; this is not live server status.

daily-reset.note: Community schedule agreement; not an official or in-game observation claim.

shugo.note: Hourly cadence agrees across Global references. Duration is the reported event window; minigame round/preparation times can differ.

invasion.note: Hourly cadence agrees across Global references. Duration is the reported event window; minigame round/preparation times can differ.

battlefield.note: Morning end time is disputed: Shugo duration column says 120 min, its description and MetaBot say 11:00–14:00. Morning window shown as 180 min, evening 120 min.

artifact.note: Shugo publishes separate service-local weekdays, start times and matching-group offsets. Korea/Taiwan rules are not converted copies of the Global schedule. Community reference; check in-game notices.

siege-bosses.note: Shugo publishes separate service-local weekdays, start times and matching-group offsets. Korea/Taiwan rules are not converted copies of the Global schedule. Community reference; check in-game notices.

nahma.note: Shugo publishes separate service-local weekdays, start times and matching-group offsets. Korea/Taiwan rules are not converted copies of the Global schedule. Community reference; check in-game notices.

kaira.note: Shugo reports Korea and Taiwan every 4 hours (6 daily starts), versus Global every 3 hours (8 starts). This is a service-specific rule, not a time-zone conversion. Not observed in game by this site.
